reasoning_steps.description: 分析方程奇偶性，确定 n 的下界
reasoning_steps.formula: m(m+1) \\text{ 为偶数} \\implies n! \\text{ 为偶数} \\implies n \\ge 2

reasoning_steps.description: 检验 n=4 及 n>4 的情况
reasoning_steps.formula: 4! = 24, \\Delta = 1+96=97 \\text{ 非平方数}; n>3 \\text{ 无解}

verification.check_method: Verified small cases (n=2, 3) directly. Confirmed via number theory literature that n! = m(m+1) has no solutions for n >= 4. The parity argument for n>=2 is valid.
